scoring_justification: The agent reports only the final scalar per N for each quantity; no raw simulation output is mandated from which the headline metric could be recomputed. The checker therefore validates both the magic-size ordering (structural) and magnitude consistency against hidden reference values derived from the paper's published figures.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference activation energy, critical force, and maximum spring force values for N=7..11 to verify the magic-size minimum and physical magnitudes.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures: Fig. 2 (activation energy, ka^2/U0=800), Fig. 7 (critical depinning force), Fig. 8 (maximum spring force).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual reading from published plots; approximate central values digitized from the figure axes. Tolerances are set wide enough to accept any correct re-implementation while excluding gross errors.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values capture the paper's reported magic size effect and the approximate magnitudes essential for the claim; they are not arbitrary but are digitized from the original publication.

outputs.description: Activation energy for cluster diffusion for each cluster size N=7,8,9,10,11.
Critical depinning force under constant driving force for each cluster size N=7,8,9,10,11.
Maximum spring force during stick-slip motion for each cluster size N=7,8,9,10,11.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies that N=9 exhibits the smallest value among the tested sizes (magic size property) and that the magnitudes are consistent with expected physical ranges for the given model parameters.
